name: Sean Walsh Park pitches
address: Sean Walsh Memorial Park, Tallaght, Dublin 24
parking: Free car park off the Old Bawn Road. Roughly 90 spaces, and it fills about 40 minutes before a senior throw-in.
accessNotes: Level tarmac path from the car park to the stand side. Two reserved wheelchair spaces on the halfway line. Accessible toilet in the changing block.
publicTransport: Luas Red Line to Tallaght, then a 12 minute walk through the park.

name: Killinarden Park
parking: On-street only along the estate road. Please leave the residents' entrances clear.
accessNotes: Grass approach from the roadside gate, which gets soft after rain. No accessible toilet on site.
publicTransport: Dublin Bus 76 and 77a stop on Killinarden Heights, 5 minutes away.

name: Tymon Park North
parking: Two council car parks, both free. The Limekiln Road entrance is usually quieter than Wellington Lane.
accessNotes: Paved loop path reaches every pitch. Accessible parking bays beside the Limekiln Road gate.

name: Tallaght Gaels clubhouse
parking: Members' car park, 40 spaces, plus overflow on match days.
accessNotes: Step-free entrance from the car park. Hearing loop at the bar counter and in the meeting room.
publicTransport: Luas Red Line to Kingswood, then a 9 minute walk.

name: Brookfield community hall
parking: Shared car park with the community centre, 25 spaces.
accessNotes: Step-free throughout. Wide doors to the hall. Quiet room available on request for anyone who needs a break from noise.

name: Jobstown handball alley
parking: Six spaces beside the court, including one accessible bay.
accessNotes: Step-free entry to the viewing area. The court floor is reached by a single 15cm step.
